messages:
Finn (People Ops): Quick ask  due to several travel and interview conflicts, please post a deputy or explicit backup in the review comments by EOD today. Use the exact template below so we can auto-extract for the audit CSV.
Asha (ENG Manager): Got it. What's the difference between deputy and backup?
Finn (People Ops): Backup = alternate who can annotate and finalize only if original reviewer is unreachable. Deputy = pre-authorized person who can finalize per scope you set. Deputies appear in the audit CSV.
Leo (SRE): If a deputy finalizes and changes rating >1 band, do we flag a calibration exception?
Finn (People Ops): Yes  deputies must add `cal-exception: true` + 1-line reason for any >1 band change. We'll queue those for rapid review.
Cam (Recruiting): I can move interviews to free up reviewer afternoons. Post names + time ranges and I'll reshuffle.
Finn (People Ops): Paste this exact block into the review comment: ```Deputy: Name (@lattice)
Scope: annotate-only | finalize-if-absent | full-delegation
Reason: PTO / travel / incident
Delegation-notes: <short text>
comp-time-eligible: <hours if applicable>```
Asha (ENG Manager): Done  adding Simone as `finalize-if-absent`.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: "Deputies/backups due" scheduled in 6 hours. :bell:
Finn (People Ops): Also reminder: redact any PII from evidence before giving deputies across regions. If you need temp view access for a deputy, DM `grant-temp <lattice-handle> <review-id>`. Thanks!
